title: A special-order lookup result shows Part Library and its vendor
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Vendor {Vendor-A} (for example the first vendor in Parts → Vendors) exists.
  • Within the last 12 months, {Location-A} received part number {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SOSRC-01) from {Vendor-A} on a special-order line of work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440).
  • Part number {Part-A} is not an inventory part at {Location-A}.
  • Work order {Work-order-2} (for example S2-15441) is open, for a ZZAUTOTEST customer, with a line {Line-1} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL special order source line").
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Work Orders.
  2. Open {Work-order-2}.
  3. In the Parts row of {Line-1} click + Add Part.
  4. In New Part Request, type {Part-A} in Part Number.
  5. Read the result offered for {Part-A} and the line under it.
  6. Close the dialog without saving.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: {Part-A} is offered as a special-order result, and its source reads "Part Library · {Vendor-A}" (the words Part Library, a middle dot, then the vendor's name). No result says "Catalog".
  • Step 6: The dialog closes and nothing is added.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
